scientificLimits: Reference recognition currently uses exact entity tokens and a conservative subset of sentence-initial coreference signals; arbitrary anaphora and omitted actors cannot be ruled out.
A user-provided before==after may be wrong; formal external ground-truth provenance is not authenticated automatically.
Training grammar and numerical operator basis remain observed constrained forms, not generic natural-language understanding.
Abstention does NOT prove the correct unknown answer is found; it prevents overclaiming.
V25 strict mode is opt-in and does not change old V17 Answer writer or automatically consume OpenThoughts3 semantic action feedback.
100% observed scores refer to structured heldout tasks, not all arbitrary text, natural language, or full mathematical problems.
No benchmark on original RTX 3050 Ti, no all-CUDA cognitive training, no 100 full OpenThoughts exercises/sec.
HTML/script checks and native HTTP controls are not browser pixel/render verification.
No universal 4D/5D intrinsic physical hyperdimensional world or real Noise Space semantics proved.
Main branch and original user checkpoint untouched, full historical exact VERBATIM remains incomplete.
